text:
jordan: Quick q — can we land a short policy for ingest-side guardrails on request/response logging? thinking about routing, quotas, and PII redaction interplay.
maya: yes please. we need something for Dedicated/Private too. customers keep asking how much they can opt-in for debug logs without exposing secrets.
sam: main constraints: (1) per-route sampling overrides, (2) redact level per route, (3) quota accounting so logging doesn't blow cost SLOs.
lex: +1. also UX: console needs a way to show effective sampling rate after rollouts (canary + global overrides). otherwise support gets 100 pings.
jordan: rough config I sketched — thoughts?

```yaml
ingest_privacy:
  default:
    sample_rate: 0.01
    redact_level: pii_mask
  route_overrides:
    /v1/chat:
      sample_rate: 0.2
      redact_level: full_mask
    /v1/embeddings:
      sample_rate: 0.005
      redact_level: pii_strip
  quota_namespace: logging_ingest
  breakglass: allow_inspect_with_approval
```

maya: looks good. question: what does `pii_mask` vs `full_mask` mean operationally?
sam: pii_mask = heuristics redaction (emails, ssn, creditcards) + keep structure. full_mask = remove entire user message content and keep only metadata. full_mask should be used for high risk routes or regulated customers.
lex: important: we need a console indicator that a route is under full_mask so engineers don't get confused when traces are blank.
security-bot: AUTOMATED NOTE: any change to redact_level must pass privacy review if it weakens masking for a route in the EU. See /policies/privacy-guidelines.
jordan: about quotas — we can surface logging budget per org and per-route consumption. plan: charge against a separate logging quota (not billable tokens) and expose burn rate in Console.
maya: +1. proposal: when a route override increases sample_rate > default by >5x require an explicit rollout note and a canary window.
sam: implementable. backend impl detail: sampler should compute effective_sample = min(route_override, org_quota_enforcer.allowed_rate(route)) so quota can clamp.
lex: UX: Console rollout flow should have:
- preview of effective sample rates across routes
- rollout note (required if >5x)
- toggle for "enable inspect for X hours" that automatically reverts
- visible flag if redaction level is full_mask
jordan: logging format: include schema tag for redact_level and sampling_version so downstream processors can make decisions. e.g. header: X-Redact-Level: full_mask, X-Sample-Proto: v2
sam: quick perf note: sampling at ingress should be lightweight — prefer probabilistic hashing on request_id + route salt instead of full token parsing.
maya: edge case: batch endpoints. if batch contains mixed PII levels we should default to highest redact_level in batch and count as 1 unit per request for quota.
lex: support ask: add a per-team whitelist (inspect allowlist) where members can request unlocks via an audit-logged flow. keep breakglass limited.
ops-bot: DEPLOYMENT: sampler-changes branch deployed to canary today 23:00 UTC. Watch logs: telemetry.alerts.sampler_error if >0.1% errors.
jordan: next steps:
- write a one-pager summarizing policy + examples (maya)
- add console mockups for preview and rollout (lex)
- implement quota clamp and header tags (sam)
- privacy review for EU impact (maya + security)
maya: I'll draft the one-pager and ping #legal once done. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
